lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: solving applied problems with similar figures
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: solving applied problems with similar figures

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: A 4 m pole casts a 2 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 10 m shadow. How tall is the building?
A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The result follows from the Pythagorean theorem applied twice.
The two parts of each side are congruent because the line is parallel.
The parallel line creates corresponding angles, giving a smaller triangle similar to the original by AA, so the sides are in proportion.
The parallel line bisects both sides by definition.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 5 corresponds to DE = 15. If BC = 8, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 7 and 112. Find the altitude.
A 7 m pole casts a 8 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 56 m shadow. How tall is the building?
The Pythagorean theorem can be proved using similarity. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The altitude to the hypotenuse creates two triangles similar to the original; writing both similarity proportions and adding them yields a² + b² = c².
The theorem follows from the triangle inequality.
The theorem follows because all right triangles are similar to each other.
Similarity gives a² + b² = c² only for isosceles right triangles.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 15 corresponds to DE = 75. If BC = 14, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 1 and 25. Find the altitude.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: A 4 m pole casts a 2 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 14 m shadow. How tall is the building?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Two triangles with all three pairs of sides in the same ratio are similar. Which statement correctly justifies it?
